projects.title: Warung Bu Inah
projects.role: 3D Environment, Prop Artist, Animator, Texture Artist

meta.Peran: 3D Environment, Prop Artist, Animator, Texture Artist

projects.overview:
Welcome to Warung Bu Inah, a small Indonesian instant noodle stall where an ordinary night shift turns into a terrifying experience.

In this 3D horror game, you take on the role of a worker tasked with managing Warung Bu Inah during the late hours of the night. At first, everything seems normal. Customers come by to order instant noodles and drinks. Your job is simple: take their orders, prepare their food, and keep the business running smoothly.

But there is something unusual about this place.

As the night goes on, strange things begin to happen. Supernatural disturbances start threatening your workplace, and you soon realize that serving customers is not your only responsibility. Scattered around the warung are mysterious ritual offerings known as sesajen. You must find and dispose of them before a sinister entity appears and starts disturbing your shift.

Keep the warung clean, serve your customers, and stay alert. One small mistake could turn an ordinary night into a terrifying nightmare.

projects.title: The(New)Rules
projects.tagline: Rules Are Made to Be Broken
projects.overview:
In this game, players are challenged to observe their surroundings, read the rules written on the walls, and discover creative ways to overcome each obstacle. Use your logic, think outside the box, and exploit the loopholes hidden within every rule to find a way out without triggering the punishment alarm.

Remember, you don't have to break the rules to beat the game. Sometimes, all you need is a different way of thinking!

projects.title: KEBELET
projects.overview:
Kebelet! (Gotta Go to the Toilet!) is a fast-paced, comedic endless runner that combines lane-switching and obstacle-dodging with that most relatable of human crisis moments: absolutely, desperately "kebelet" (gotta go to the toilet) with no time to waste!
Run through chaotic streets, dodge unexpected obstacles, jump over roadblocks, and slide under them in a frantic race against time to reach the nearest restroom. However, speed alone won't be enough to survive.

projects.title: Bunker Proocol
projects.overview:
Bunker Proocol adalah game survival berbasis UI singkat tentang bertahan semalaman menjaga sebuah bunker bawah tanah agar tidak jatuh ke tangan mutan.

Seorang teknisi shift malam duduk sendirian di ruang kendali, memantau radar yang mulai berkedip tanda ada yang menjebol dinding luar. Setiap sektor yang terancam berteriak minta daya, sementara generator cadangan tak cukup untuk menyalakan semuanya sekaligus — ia harus memutuskan sektor mana yang layak diselamatkan.

Setiap keputusan yang tepat menahan laju kegagalan, menutup blast door tepat waktu, dan menjaga cahaya tetap menyala di sektor-sektor vital. Namun satu klik yang salah membuat sebuah sektor jatuh sepenuhnya, memutus jalur listrik ke ruangan sekitarnya dan membiarkan mutan merembet lebih dalam menuju waktu tertentu.

projects.title: Nicholas Flight
projects.overview:
Nicholas bangun terlalu siang! Alarmnya tidak berbunyi dan waktu hampir habis. Jika dia tidak segera berangkat, dia akan terlambat!

Tapi sebelum pergi, ada satu masalah besar... koper Nicholas masih kosong!

Pemain harus membantu Nicholas menyusun berbagai barang ke dalam koper dengan ruang yang sangat terbatas. Setiap barang memiliki bentuk yang berbeda, jadi kamu harus memutar dan menempatkannya dengan cerdas agar semuanya muat.
